title: Aromatic Silky Dutch Oats Pudding
description: A post-workout Dutch dish featuring rolled oats, tandoor, and sugar-free-friendly ingredients, with a bitter and silky texture. This pudding is perfect for a healthy dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: rolled oats
ingredients.notes: old-fashioned or quick-cooking oats work well

ingredients.name: tandoor spice blend
ingredients.notes: or garam masala as a substitute

instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the almond milk to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the rolled oats, tandoor spice blend, stevia powder, and salt to the saucepan.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the coconut oil and vanilla extract.
Let the pudding cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Before serving, give the pudding a good stir and adjust the sweetness or spice level to taste.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of tandoor spice blend if desired.
